# CLI reference (`blazma-anim`)

```
blazma-anim commands [--json]
blazma-anim new <file.blazanim> [--name NAME] [--json]
blazma-anim inspect <file> [--json]
blazma-anim exec <file> <command-id> [--args '<json>'] [--arg key=value ...] [--no-save] [--json]
blazma-anim run <file> <script.jsonl> [--no-save] [--json]
blazma-anim docs <out-dir>
```

Every command except `new`, `commands` and `docs` also accepts `--attach` (omit the file argument) to drive the running Blazma Animation window instead of a file. `--pipe <name>` overrides the IPC pipe name (tests only).

## Sub-commands

| Sub-command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `commands` | Lists every command with its effect and arguments. |
| `new` | Creates a project containing the default mannequin. Fails if the file exists. |
| `inspect` | Same as `exec <file> project.inspect`. |
| `exec` | Runs one command inside one task, then saves atomically (unless `--no-save`, a read-only command, or a failure). `--args` takes a JSON object; `--arg key=value` can repeat and is converted using the command's schema. |
| `run` | Runs a JSON-lines script (one `{"command":"key.set","args":{...}}` per line; blank lines and lines starting with `#` are skipped) in ONE task. Stops at the first failure without saving; otherwise saves once. Script variables: `${character}` (the project's first character) and `${clip}` (its last clip) are replaced inside string arguments; `"save":{"name":"field"}` on a line stores `data.field` of its result as `${name}` for later lines (e.g. `{"command":"clip.create","args":{"name":"Walk"},"save":{"clip":"clipId"}}`). |
| `docs` | Writes `MCP_TOOLS.md` and `CLI_REFERENCE.md` into the folder. |

## Output and exit codes

Default output is human-readable text; `--json` prints machine-readable JSON on stdout (for `exec`: the `CommandResult`; for `run`: `{ok, steps:[...], saved}`). Errors go to stderr.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | User or input error (bad arguments, file locked, command failed) |
| 2 | Validation failure (reserved) |
| 3 | Internal error |
| 130 | Cancelled (Ctrl+C) |

## Argument details

### `anim.evaluate`

The pose a clip produces at a frame (does not change anything). Returns per-bone rotation/position and the pose JSON. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame (may be fractional). |

### `anim.pose_from_frame`

Set the character's working pose to what the clip gives at a frame (undoable). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame. |

### `animation.export`

Export a clip as a .glb animation (glTF 2.0 binary) plus a '<name>.blazma.json' sidecar (fps, loop, markers, events, root motion, bone map). The built-in mannequin gets a new file with a simple mesh; an imported character's original file is kept and the animation is appended. Writes files outside the project (the project itself is not changed); agents may only create new files. The written file is re-read and validated. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character to export with (default: the first character using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb to create; its folder must exist. (min length 1) |
| `rootMotion` | string | no | keep (default) \| in_place (remove the root's horizontal X/Z travel, keep height) \| in_place_all (remove all root translation). (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame to export (default 0); it becomes time 0 in the file. (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame to export, inclusive (default: clip length). (min 0) |
| `sidecar` | boolean | no | Also write '<name>.blazma.json' next to the .glb (default true). |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | Replace existing files (default false). Ignored for agents, which can only create new files. |

### `animation.validate`

Re-read an exported .glb and compare it with the clip frame by frame (position 1e-4 m, rotation 0.01°, scale 1e-4) and check its glTF structure, hierarchy and duration. Returns ok, max errors and issues. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb. (min length 1) |
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character the file was exported with (default: as for animation.export). (min length 1) |

### `character.remove`

Remove a character from the scene (undoable). (effect: destructive)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |

### `clip.add_phase_markers`

Add the 7 key-pose phase markers (Initial … Final) spread over the clip; phases that already have a marker are skipped. Returns {added, markers:[{markerId,name,frame,phase}]}. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |

### `clip.create`

Create an empty animation clip. Returns its clipId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Clip name. (min length 1) |
| `durationFrames` | integer | no | Length in frames (default: 1 second). (min 1) |
| `fpsNumerator` | integer | no | Frame rate numerator (default: project frame rate). (min 1) |
| `fpsDenominator` | integer | no | Frame rate denominator (default 1). (min 1) |

### `clip.delete`

Delete a clip (undoable). (effect: destructive)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |

### `clip.rename`

Rename a clip. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | yes | New name. (min length 1) |

### `clip.set_duration`

Set a clip's length in frames. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `frames` | integer | yes | Length in frames (≥ 1). (min 1) |

### `clip.set_loop`

Enable/disable looping and optionally set the loop range (startFrame < endFrame ≤ clip length). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | Loop on or off. |
| `startFrame` | number | no | Loop start frame. |
| `endFrame` | number | no | Loop end frame (exclusive); the clip length means clip end. |

### `key.auto_tangents`

Reset keys' tangents to automatic. Filter by track and/or frames; omit both for every key. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `trackId` | string | no | Track id; omit for all tracks. (min length 1) |
| `frames` | string | no | Comma-separated frames; omit for all. (min length 1) |

### `key.copy`

Copy keys (optionally only some frames/bones) as JSON in 'keysJson', frames relative to the earliest copied frame. Does not change anything. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `frames` | string | no | Comma-separated frames; omit for all. (min length 1) |
| `bones` | string | no | Comma-separated bone/control names or ids; omit for all. (min length 1) |

### `key.delete`

Delete keys at the given frames (optionally only for some bones/controls). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `frames` | string | yes | Comma-separated frame numbers, e.g. "0,12". (min length 1) |
| `bones` | string | no | Comma-separated bone/control names or ids; omit for all. (min length 1) |

### `key.move`

Shift keys at the given frames by 'delta' frames (keys they land on are replaced). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `frames` | string | yes | Comma-separated frame numbers. (min length 1) |
| `delta` | number | yes | Frames to move (may be negative). |
| `bones` | string | no | Comma-separated names or ids; omit for all. (min length 1) |

### `key.paste`

Paste keys from key.copy at a frame (replaces keys at the same times, creates tracks, extends the clip if needed). Targets unknown to the clip's rig are ignored with a warning. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `keysJson` | string | yes | JSON produced by key.copy. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame where the copied block starts. |

### `key.set`

Record the character's current pose as keys at a frame (replaces existing keys there). By default every bone and IK control; pass 'bones' to key only some. Binds the clip to the character's rig on first use. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame number (≥ 0). |
| `bones` | string | no | Comma-separated bone/control names or ids; omit for all. (min length 1) |
| `interpolation` | string | no | step \| linear \| cubic (default cubic for new keys). (min length 1) |

### `key.set_interpolation`

Set how motion leaves the given keys: step, linear or cubic. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `interpolation` | string | yes | step \| linear \| cubic. (min length 1) |
| `frames` | string | no | Comma-separated frames; omit for all keys. (min length 1) |
| `bones` | string | no | Names or ids; omit for all. (min length 1) |

### `key.set_tangents`

Make a key's tangents explicit (value per second) and set one component's in/out slope. Other components keep their current auto values, so the curve does not jump. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `trackId` | string | yes | Track id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Key frame. |
| `component` | integer | yes | Component index (0-based). |
| `inSlope` | number | no | Incoming slope (value/second). |
| `outSlope` | number | no | Outgoing slope (value/second). |

### `key.set_value`

Set one component of the key at a frame. Rotation keys are renormalized afterwards. Pinned channel accepts 0 or 1 (component 0). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `trackId` | string | yes | Track id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Key frame. |
| `component` | integer | yes | Component index (0-based). |
| `value` | number | yes | New value. |

Add a named marker (optionally a key-pose phase) at a frame. Returns {markerId}. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |

| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame (whole number, 0 ≤ frame < clip length). |
| `name` | string | yes | Marker name. (min length 1) |
| `phase` | string | no | none \| initial \| anticipation \| main_action \| contact \| follow_through \| recovery \| final. (min length 1) |

|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | no | Rig id (or use characterId). (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character whose rig to inspect. (min length 1) |

### `rig.map_bone`

Correct the humanoid mapping: give a bone a Blazma standard name (e.g. thigh_l), or omit 'standard' to unmap it. IK chains are rebuilt. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | yes | Rig id. (min length 1) |
| `bone` | string | yes | Bone id or name. (min length 1) |
| `standard` | string | no | Standard bone name; omit to unmap. (min length 1) |

### `rig.mapping_report`

Bone-mapping report for a rig: assignments, missing bones and issues. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | yes | Rig id. (min length 1) |

### `scene.add_mannequin`

Add the built-in humanoid mannequin to the scene. Returns characterId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Character name (default 'Mannequin'). (min length 1) |

### `track.set_flags`

Lock/unlock and/or mute/unmute a track (at least one flag). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `trackId` | string | yes | Track id. (min length 1) |
| `locked` | boolean | no | Locked tracks cannot be edited. |
| `muted` | boolean | no | Muted tracks are not evaluated. |
